commits.message:
fix(host): the vertical wheel is onWheel's alone; cards scroll the page a whole notch (rich-demos-k78j.d24)

Review (high): onMouse no longer hears scroll_up/down (AppMouseEvent), so an
app cannot move something with a turn and still pass it outward; WidgetApp
gains onWheel; only a running app is offered or passes a turn. The card
scrolls the page by the reporting event's own distance, and a terminal with
no pointer reporting leaves the wheel to the page instead of turning it into
arrow keys. e2e pointer columns come from card.json.

feat(host): a wheel no app moves anything with scrolls the page (rich-demos-k78j.d24)

App offers every wheel notch to onWheel consumers and passes one none moved
anything with to the new required TerminalHost.passWheel. WidgetApp's one
consumer is its router's viewport scroll. NodeTerminalHost hands it to a stdout
that carries passWheel (the card's stand-in) and otherwise does nothing; the
card's worker posts it and the page scrolls by that many terminal rows.

Deviation from the ticket's design: the card's programs run on
NodeTerminalHost in the worker, so the way out is an optional passWheel on the
stdout stream rather than BrowserTerminalHost alone.

feat(renderables): ListView, moveSelection, ViewportPerKey (rich-demos-k78j.3gp) (#379)

* feat(renderables): ListView, moveSelection, ViewportPerKey ship beside Viewport (rich-demos-k78j.3gp)

The demos' copies move into the library: ItemsInView becomes ListView (gap and
context options), the clamped selection moves become moveSelection, and
examples/shared/ViewportPerSubject becomes ViewportPerKey. Viewport.follow
brings a range into view only when it changes, so a ListView rebuilt every
frame no longer undoes the wheel's scroll. rich-dash's RateSparkline gains a
natural width, which keeps withBoundedWidth demonstrated.

* fix(renderables): follow re-brings the selection in when rows shrink; ListView refuses bad indices (rich-demos-k78j.3gp)

Review high: panes rebuilt per frame follow instead of ensuring; Dropdown
moves through moveSelection; RateSparkline's minimum is 0.

* fix(renderables): ListView measures at unbounded width; sidebar scrolls per list (rich-demos-k78j.3gp)

Review medium: gutter read from the viewport, not subtracted from Infinity;
claude-sessions' sidebar holds a viewport per level so follow does not
mistake two lists' line 1 for one selection.

* fix(renderables): follow holds only a shown selection across a resize; gap sits between items (rich-demos-k78j.3gp)

Review high (escalation): moveSelection moves to core/selection so widgets
gains no edge into renderables; Viewport reads its own gutter getter;
docs/viewport.md describes follow.
